name: Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva Variant

criteria.description: Presence of congenital skeletal malformations atypical for classic FOP (e.g., absence of great toe malformations)
Progressive heterotopic ossification in characteristic anatomic patterns
Identification of atypical ACVR1 gene mutations distinct from classic R206H mutation
Recurrent soft tissue flare-ups preceding ossification
Lack of great toe malformation typically seen in classic FOP

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive heterotopic ossification plus identification of atypical ACVR1 mutation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis may require genetic testing due to atypical presentation

pathognomonic.symptomName: Progressive heterotopic ossification of soft tissues
searchTerms: gradual abnormal bone growth in soft tissue
bone forming in muscles and skin

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital skeletal malformations atypical for classic FOP
searchTerms: unusual bone malformations present at birth
congenital bone abnormalities different from classic patterns

common.symptomName: Restricted joint mobility due to ossification
searchTerms: joint movement limited by bone growth
stiff joints due to abnormal ossification

common.symptomName: Pain localized to affected areas during flare-ups
searchTerms: pain in affected areas during flare-ups

common.symptomName: Mild skeletal deformities other than great toe malformations
searchTerms: mild bone deformities besides big toe
minor skeletal abnormalities other than great toe
small bone shape changes excluding big toe

occasional.symptomName: Muscle weakness adjacent to ossified areas
searchTerms: reduced strength next to bone growth
weak muscles adjacent to abnormal bone

occasional.symptomName: Mild respiratory restriction due to thoracic ossification
searchTerms: breathing difficulty from chest bone growth
mild lung restriction due to thoracic ossification
reduced respiratory capacity from chest bone changes
joint stiffness not caused by bone growth
red skin patches with flare episodes

rare.symptomName: Cardiovascular complications secondary to thoracic cage restriction
searchTerms: heart and blood vessel problems from chest restriction
cardiovascular issues due to limited chest movement
heart complications secondary to thoracic cage stiffness

rare.symptomName: Hearing impairment due to ossification near auditory structures
searchTerms: hearing loss from bone near ear
decreased hearing caused by abnormal bone growth
shooting pain due to nerve entrapment

laboratory: Elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) during flare-ups
imaging: Heterotopic bone formation visible on X-ray and CT scans
Absence or atypical presentation of great toe malformations on skeletal survey
genetic: Presence of atypical ACVR1 gene mutations distinct from classic R206H mutation
other: Soft tissue swelling and inflammation preceding ossification episodes

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of classic great toe malformations
Heterotopic ossification begins in dermis and subcutaneous fat

redFlags: Rapidly progressive heterotopic ossification causing joint ankylosis
Respiratory compromise due to thoracic cage involvement
references: Kaplan FS, Shore EM. Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva: Diagnosis, Management, and Therapeutic Horizons. Pediatr Endocrinol Rev. 2015;13 Suppl 2:690-701.
